prompt: Write a one-star review of Yellowstone from a driver whose schedule was disrupted by bison.
response:
**One-Star Review: "Bison Don't Care About Your Timetable"**

I planned my entire day around driving through Yellowstone—tight schedule, important meetings via Bluetooth, the works. What I got instead was a 45-minute standstill because a herd of bison decided the road was their personal lounging spot. No honking, no yelling, no nothing moved them. One even stared at my rental car like it owed him money.

By the time they finally sauntered off, I’d missed two calls, my fuel was lower, and my blood pressure was higher than Old Faithful. If you’re in a hurry, on a deadline, or just like arriving on time, skip this so-called “national treasure.” The bison clearly run the park and they don’t respect anyone’s schedule but their own.

Never again.
